gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (p4) prints one row 'Transfers in (out), net': General Fund 4,833,642, Community Betterment Fund (755,000), Debt Service Fund (3,800,642), Total 278,000; the statement JSON uses the Total-column net 278,000 (other side: Waste Water Fund Transfers Out (278,000), p8). detail[] records transfers gross per fund: the only transfer in is General Fund 'Transfers in, net' 4,833,642 (budget schedule p5, same figure as the GAAP column). 4,833,642 - 755,000 - 3,800,642 = 278,000 = printed net, so the 4,555,642 gap is the gross-vs-net basis; no change to transfers in. The Debt Service Fund (3,800,642) is not in detail[] and is added in the 'other financing' entry below (it is a transfer out, so it does not change this transfers_in total). The LB840 Funds schedule 'Transfers' (2,412,177) (p10, already in detail as Transfers Out) is a supplementary schedule inside the General Fund GAAP column and has no column of its own on p4.

Proprietary fund statement of revenues, expenses and changes in fund net position (p8) prints one column, Waste Water Fund; no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Charges for services 11,933,040 + Annexation revenue 10,248 + Government grants 624,600 = 12,567,888 = statement total.
